environment: Isolated local demo, production not modified

results.name: Team creation and vacant District Manager
results.detail: Area → State branch, receiving CF/JCF and unrelated AP branch created.

results.name: Admin QR → District → Area → three machine types → farmers
results.detail: 100 QR labels; 3 machines; CF, JCF and Area each onboard a farmer; batch extended to 150 without changing attached labels.

results.name: Season 1 opening
results.detail: All three readiness inspections; MCP opening 1,000 rev with proof; early final submission denied.

results.name: Season 1 completion
results.detail: MCP 300 ac + drum 200 ac + laser 0 ac = 500 ac; 3 pre and 3 post checks; 2-acre optional visit not added twice.

results.name: All four maintenance approvals and field completion
results.detail: Area → District → State → FM final → Admin coordinates → JCF repair report; restored workable; completion alerts reach all seven roles.

results.name: Between-season transfer and farmer change
results.detail: Same QR to Sangareddy CF via direct Area → State branch; original farmer archived, new farmer registered, old photos/rate retained.

results.name: Season 2 readiness, scope and missing-manager routing
results.detail: MCP-only alert in Sangareddy; drum/laser plan in Nizamabad; failed trial escalates; absent District stage skipped but FM approval retained; new opening uses 2,000 rev/ac.

results.name: Two-season analytics for every role
results.detail: 900 ac combined: Soybean 150, Maize 360, Paddy 390; original branch retains 650 historical ac; receiving branch sees its own 250; AP branch sees 0; 6 reports, 12 inspections.

results.name: Corrections, persistence, calibration and read-alert state
results.detail: Saved reports keep separate rates/geography; revision replaces instead of double-counting; redispatch preserves read status; all values persisted in demo store.

results.name: Late onboarding and existing-campaign backfill
results.detail: New CF and JCF receive existing MCP campaign immediately; dispatch repairs old saved recipient lists without duplicate reminders or resetting read status.

results.name: Strict calendar validation
results.detail: Invalid month/day and non-leap 29 February rejected on create and edit; valid 29 February 2028 retained.
